physical_scale_and_placement_notes.css_user_unit_mapping: SVG class .title has CSS font-size 12.5px, which equals 12.5pt when placed at 468pt canvas width in Word report.
physical_scale_and_placement_notes.pdf_native_geometry_and_scaling: PDF native width is 351.12pt (browser CSS px-to-pt ratio 0.75), yielding native text ~6.38pt; scaling to 468pt Word placement yields >= 8.5pt physical print scale. Standalone 100% unscaled PDF print does not claim 8.5pt.
physical_scale_and_placement_notes.png_placement_scale: PNG 468x550 / 468x440 achieves minimum 8.5pt font size when placed at 468pt column width in Word report document.

role_mapping_and_governance.legacy_figure1_defect_record: The label '$0.0526 hold/request' belonged to legacy unapproved draft Figure 1 (fig1_system_architecture) and conflated whole-study prior-pilot hold ($0.05264010) with per-request reservations. Legacy Figure 1 was not selected as final authority. The approved report print variant strictly uses 'USD19.99 study cap; reserve before dispatch' and 'No in-flight prompt mutations; retries recorded in attempt journal' without claiming per-request hold or implying zero retries (accounting for 1 transport retry across 6,401 attempts / 6,400 records).

scientific_data_integrity.observational_caveat: Subgroup differences are observational (association-only); retrieval hit/miss is not randomly assigned.
